newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 17,400 MT were primarily the result of major increases for Saudi Arabia (20,000 MT), Canada (9,200 MT), and New Zealand (5,000 MT) being partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (20,000 MT, switched to Saudi Arabia).

Exports of 83,400 MT were two-thirds above the previous week and 63 percent above the 4-week average. Saudi Arabia (20,000 MT), Canada (14,200 MT), and Australia (12,300 MT) were the principal recipients.
